{{DISPLAYTITLE:Key Items in {{BotW|-}}}} {{BasePageLink|Key Item}} The following is a list of [[Key Item]]s that appear in {{BotW}}. __TOC__ ==Overview== There are 36 Key Items. Unlike regular [[Item]]s, [[Link]] cannot take them out of the [[Inventory]]. [[Horse Gear]] can be given to specific [[Stable Worker]]s in order to equip them onto Link's [[Horse]], the [[Medallion]] can be placed on the ground and the [[Champions]]' powers can be used indefinitely. ===List of Key Items=== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Key Item [Image:Icon:100px][Link][Nowrap], Description[Transcript], Obtained from [Description] |- | Sheikah Slate | A mysterious tablet with a glowing center.
